title: S End To End
description: Get s (the semio OS shell under ✏️s with every registered plugin, app and artifact) working end to end: the registered launch targets boot the React and WGPU shells, the complete plugin catalog loads without hardcoded identities, every declared app and artifact opens and renders non-empty content with live mutations, and the registered collaboration/browser/native smoke gates pass with current runtime evidence. Coordinated from Claude Fable 5.1 with Opus 5 implementers and Sonnet 5 read-only explorers alongside the concurrent COMPLETE-SEMIO-END-TO-END fleet.
